edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve fully and finally all claims, known or unknown, asserted or that could have been asserted, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action, subject to the terms of this Agreement.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. The parties shall exchange any reasonably necessary tax or payment information in connection with this payment.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon timely receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff, for itself and its affiliates, agents, successors, and assigns, releases and forever discharges Defendant and its affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims, demands, causes of action, liabilities, damages, costs, and expenses of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this action. Defendant shall provide a reciprocal release to Plaintiff on the same terms, except for obligations created by this Agreement.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms and existence of this settlement are strictly confidential and shall not be disclosed to any person except: (a) to a party's attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, and immediate family members who have a need to know and are bound to maintain confidentiality; (b) as required by law, regulation, subpoena, court order, or other legal process, provided the disclosing party gives prompt notice to the other side to the extent legally permitted; and (c) as necessary to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this paragraph prohibits a party from disclosing information already in the public domain.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not, and shall not be construed as, an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by either party. Neither this Agreement nor the settlement payment may be offered or used as evidence except to enforce the terms of this Agreement or as otherwise required by law.
edits.name: no_admission
